description: HIPAA Security Rule technical safeguards for protection of electronic Protected Health Information (ePHI). These controls govern access, audit, integrity, authentication, and transmission security for any system that stores, processes, or transmits ePHI.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: Implement technical policies and procedures for electronic information systems that maintain ePHI to allow access only to those persons or software programs that have been granted access rights.

enforcement.message: Role-based access control must be enabled
enforcement.fix: RBAC is enabled by default. Ensure roles table has entries and users are assigned roles.

enforcement.message: Default deny policy must be active (unauthenticated requests blocked)
enforcement.fix: This is enforced by the auth middleware. No action needed if middleware is active.

controls.title: Unique User Identification
controls.description: Assign a unique name and/or number for identifying and tracking user identity.

enforcement.message: Every user must have a unique UUID
enforcement.fix: UUIDs are generated automatically on registration. No action needed.

enforcement.message: Audit log entries must include user_id for tracking
enforcement.fix: Ensure audit logging is enabled: AUDIT_LOG_ENABLED=true

controls.title: Emergency Access Procedure
controls.description: Establish and implement as needed procedures for obtaining necessary ePHI during an emergency.

enforcement.message: Emergency access procedure must be configured
enforcement.fix: Emergency access is available via the management API with admin credentials. Document your emergency access procedure.

controls.title: Automatic Logoff
controls.description: Implement electronic procedures that terminate an electronic session after a predetermined time of inactivity.

enforcement.message: Session timeout must be 15 minutes or less for HIPAA
enforcement.fix: Set SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES=15 (or less) in your environment

enforcement.message: Session timeout must be actively enforced (not just token expiry)
enforcement.fix: Session timeout enforcement is automatic in HIPAA compliance mode

controls.title: Encryption and Decryption
controls.description: Implement a mechanism to encrypt and decrypt ePHI.

enforcement.message: JWT signing must use asymmetric cryptography (EdDSA or RS256), not HS256
enforcement.fix: Set JWT_ALGORITHM=EdDSA (default) or RS256

enforcement.message: Passwords must be hashed with Argon2id
enforcement.fix: Argon2id is the default. No action needed.

enforcement.message: TLS 1.2 or higher must be enforced for all connections
enforcement.fix: Set TLS_MIN_VERSION=1.2 and ensure your reverse proxy enforces TLS

controls.title: Audit Controls
controls.description: Implement hardware, software, and/or procedural mechanisms that record and examine activity in information systems that contain or use ePHI.

enforcement.message: Audit logging must be enabled
enforcement.fix: Set AUDIT_LOG_ENABLED=true

enforcement.message: Audit log must be append-only (no updates or deletes)
enforcement.fix: Audit log immutability is enforced at the application level. No action needed.

enforcement.message: Audit entries must include: timestamp, event_id, user_id, action, resource, ip_address, result
enforcement.fix: All required fields are logged automatically. No action needed.

controls.title: Integrity
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to protect ePHI from improper alteration or destruction.

enforcement.message: JWT signatures must be verified on every request
enforcement.fix: JWT verification is automatic. No action needed.

enforcement.message: Refresh tokens must be rotated on every use (one-time use)
enforcement.fix: Token rotation is automatic. No action needed.

enforcement.message: Reuse of revoked refresh tokens must be detected and trigger family revocation
enforcement.fix: Token family tracking is automatic. No action needed.

controls.title: Person or Entity Authentication
controls.description: Implement procedures to verify that a person or entity seeking access to ePHI is the one claimed.

enforcement.message: Multi-factor authentication must be required for all users
enforcement.fix: Set MFA_REQUIRED=true

enforcement.message: Passwords must be at least 8 characters
enforcement.fix: Set PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH=8 (or higher)

controls.title: Transmission Security
controls.description: Implement technical security measures to guard against unauthorized access to ePHI that is being transmitted over an electronic communications network.

enforcement.message: TLS 1.2 or higher must be enforced
enforcement.fix: Set TLS_MIN_VERSION=1.2 and configure your reverse proxy

enforcement.message: Cookies must have Secure flag (HTTPS only)
enforcement.fix: Secure cookies are automatic in compliance modes. No action needed.
